ca-45-1-c-22.title: Senate committee reports Bill C-22 with amendments
ca-45-1-c-22.delta: The November 26 Ninth Report provides the amendment text sought in the previous run. LEGISinfo now records Senate report stage.
ca-45-1-c-22.next: Watch Senate concurrence, further amendments, third reading and any Commons response. Check the final enacted text and commencement separately.
unknowns: The report alone establishes neither enactment nor a legal obligation on a particular provider in Montréal.

facts.statement: The Senate committee presented its Ninth Report on November 26. Parliament records completion of committee consideration and the start of Senate report stage.

citations.selector: Summary and Senate consideration in committee

facts.statement: For clause 41 the committee proposed a necessity and proportionality test for each obligation imposed by regulation or ministerial order. It also proposed clarifying the systemic-vulnerability definition to cover risks of unauthorized alteration and specified weakening of electronic protections. The Commons-passed version required consideration of listed factors.

citations.selector: Clause 41, systemic vulnerability and proposed subsections 5(3) and 7(3)

gl-inet-goodcloud-2026-11.title: GL.iNet investigates older malware reports
gl-inet-goodcloud-2026-11.delta: The November 26 vendor revision adds a second timeline for investigation. The connection to the November 20 GoodCloud incident is unresolved.
gl-inet-goodcloud-2026-11.next: Check later vendor revisions for the origin of the earlier files and any change in customer recovery guidance.
unknowns: The dates on older files do not establish an intrusion date, shared attacker, or compromise of a connected computer.

facts.statement: GL.iNet says it is investigating older router malware. It attributes file dates as early as September 2025 to an outside researcher and is still determining how the files arrived and whether they relate to the November incident.

cisa-kev-2026-11-25.title: CISA adds ten entries to its known exploited vulnerabilities catalog
cisa-kev-2026-11-25.delta: Catalog 2026.11.25 adds ten CVEs since the November 24 baseline. No prior CVE record was removed or modified in this revision.
cisa-kev-2026-11-25.jurisdiction: United States federal catalog, multiple vendors
cisa-kev-2026-11-25.next: Compare the next KEV revision by CVE and check for public disclosures of downstream impact.
unknowns: The catalog entries do not identify affected organizations or a Factory deployment.

facts.statement: A CVE-keyed comparison of the two immutable JSON revisions gives 1,805 entries, up from 1,795. The additions cover Mitel MiCollab (five), Danfoss AK-SM 800A (three), Juniper Session Smart (one) and Vates Xen Orchestra (one).

citations.selector: catalogVersion, count, vulnerabilities by cveID and dateAdded

montreal-urban-cameras-26-21620.title: Montréal seeks bids for urban security cameras
montreal-urban-cameras-26-21620.delta: First coverage of the October 28 solicitation fills the prior watch’s procurement gap at the tender stage.
montreal-urban-cameras-26-21620.next: Check the December 1 opening, subsequent addenda, council award and deployment records independently.
unknowns: The tender record establishes no award, supplier, deployment, use, retention policy or camera location.

facts.statement: The city advertised acquisition and installation of urban security cameras under notice 26-21620. The initial open-contracting release lists a December 1, 2026 deadline at 13:30 Montréal time.
